title: Phase 1 acceptance, SPEC v0.1, v0.1.0 release draft, PR
goal: Freeze SPEC v0.1, run the full regression on all 5 targets, collect Joel’s IME checklist, prepare v0.1.0 and open the PR to main.
scope: SPEC v0.1 frozen; tag v0.1.0; GitHub release as draft with dist/blank.html and a demo document

rules.rule: Release stays a draft; the PR stays open.

criteria: All gates green on all 5 targets.
Every X-04 row passes or is documented as a known limitation with evidence.
SPEC v0.1 tagged; release draft contains dist/blank.html and the demo document.
PR open with a summary of all pieces, rounds and the size log.
acceptance.critic: Criteria plus one end-to-end session run by the critic through the harness (type, format, paste, undo, save, reopen) on all targets.
